abstract: When aggregates of HM-1 embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells were exposed to 10(-6) M retinoic acid for 2 days and cultured in medium lacking retinoic acid, they differentiated to nerve cells, endoderm cells, and myoblasts. Cells 2 days after initial exposure to retinoic acid were not significantly different from the parental EC cells, as judged by cell-surface architecture and by reactivity to lectins. On the fourth day, the surface of the aggregates was covered with two kinds of cells distinguishable from the parental cells. The round cells with short villi seemed to be precursors to endoderm cells. Receptors for Dolichos biflorus agglutinin (DBA) newly appeared and receptors for peanut agglutinin (PNA) were still expressed on their surfaces. The other cells, which were round cells with a few processes, might be precursors to nerve cells. PNA receptors had disappeared from their surfaces, and DBA receptors were not expressed. On the sixth day of differentiation, possible precursors to myoblasts were detected; they were flat cells with smooth surfaces. These cells lacked cell-surface receptors for the two lectins, while the precursor cells and the myoblasts excreted intercellular fibers reacting with PNA. HM-1 cells synthesized much embryoglycan, the structure of which was similar to that of the glycan isolated from quasinullipotent F9 cells. The only difference was that the glycan from HM-1 cells lacked DBA binding sites. Synthesis of fucosylated embryoglycan mainly decreased between the second and fourth day of differentiation. As above, cell-surface changes occurred mainly between the second and fourth day. The period seems to be important in determining the fate of the cells, since endoderm cells were scarcely seen among differentiated cells which had been continuously exposed to 10(-6) M retinoic acid during the period.
abstract_ja: HM-1胎児性癌（EC）細胞の凝集塊を10⁻⁶ Mのレチノイン酸に2日間曝露し、レチノイン酸を含まない培地で培養したところ、神経細胞、内胚葉細胞、筋芽細胞に分化した。曝露開始後2日目の細胞は、細胞表面の構造およびレクチン反応性において親EC細胞と有意な差はみられなかった。4日目には、凝集塊の表面は親細胞と区別される2種類の細胞で覆われた。短い絨毛を持つ丸い細胞は内胚葉細胞の前駆細胞と思われた。この細胞ではDolichos biflorus agglutinin（DBA）の受容体が新たに出現し、peanut agglutinin（PNA）の受容体は表面に残存していた。もう一方の、少数の突起を持つ丸い細胞は神経細胞の前駆細胞と思われた。この細胞ではPNA受容体は消失し、DBA受容体は発現していなかった。分化6日目には、筋芽細胞の前駆細胞と思われる細胞が検出された。これは表面が滑らかな扁平細胞で、2種類のレクチンに対する細胞表面受容体を欠いていた。一方、前駆細胞と筋芽細胞はPNAと反応する細胞間線維を分泌していた。HM-1細胞は多量の胚性糖鎖（embryoglycan）を合成し、その構造は準無多能性のF9細胞から単離された糖鎖と類似していた。唯一の違いは、HM-1細胞由来の糖鎖にはDBA結合部位が欠けていたことである。フコース化胚性糖鎖の合成は主に2日目から4日目の間に減少した。同様に、細胞表面の変化も主に2日目から4日目の間に生じた。この期間は細胞の運命を決定する上で重要と思われる。内胚葉細胞がほとんど見られなかったのは、この期間中に10⁻⁶ Mのレチノイン酸に継続的に曝露された分化細胞においてであった。
